name: Beast of the switchback
description: A beast with a thick, snow-white fleece mane that kills a rabbit and scatters Pavios's pack.

timeline.summary: A white-maned beast kills and devours a rabbit, notices Pavios, and he flees down the switchback into a cave.
timeline.quote: Panicked, Pavios bolted in the opposite direction
